title: A flexible and affordable self-driving laboratory for automated reaction optimization
claim: RoboChem-Flex supports modular closed-loop and human-in-the-loop optimization across several reaction classes.
boundary: Existing flow automation, not an LLM batch-to-flow proposal benchmark.

title: El agente cuántico: automating quantum simulations
claim: Aspuru-Guzik and collaborators orchestrate software-specific agents for quantum simulations.
boundary: Computational physics workflows, not wet-laboratory flow-process design.

title: The virtual lab of AI agents designs new SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies
claim: Specialist agents and human guidance supported experimentally tested nanobody design.
boundary: A task-specific biological demonstration, not proof that multi-agent designs are universally superior.

title: Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist
claim: Co-Scientist uses hypothesis generation, critique, ranking and refinement.
boundary: Different system from the 2023 chemistry Coscientist; biomedical scope.

title: A multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery
claim: Robin connects literature-based reasoning with experimental proposals and analysis.
boundary: Does not establish autonomous operation of chemical flow equipment.

title: Verification and execution of the scientific literature via chemputation augmented by large language models
claim: ACRA translates literature procedures into hardware-constrained executable XDL descriptions.
boundary: Direct prior art for hardware-aware protocol translation; do not claim that general capability is new in FlowPilot.

title: AutoLabs: cognitive multi-agent systems with self-correction for autonomous chemical experimentation
claim: User clarification, calculation tools and self-correction produce liquid-handler procedures.
boundary: Empirical scope is a particular liquid handler, not general flow chemistry.

title: Reimagining research papers as interactive and reliable AI agents
claim: Paper2Agent converts papers and associated code into tested interactive tools.
boundary: Primarily computational biology demonstrations; not arbitrary paper-to-robot execution.

title: El Agente Gráfico: A Semantic Execution Runtime for Scientific Agents
claim: Typed execution state and explicit transitions structure scientific-agent execution.
boundary: Preprint, not a peer-reviewed Nature paper; latest v2 title differs from v1.

title: La Agente Óptima: Towards Agentic Self-Driving Laboratories
claim: Agent-supervised optimization campaigns include a physical flow-chemistry demonstration.
boundary: Preprint; campaign supervision/optimization is not the same task as initial process design.

title: A framework for evaluating the chemical knowledge and reasoning abilities of large language models against the expertise of chemists
claim: ChemBench shows strong aggregate performance alongside basic errors and overconfidence.
boundary: Question-answer benchmark, not direct evidence about FlowPilot outcomes.

title: PRISM: protocol refinement through intelligent simulation modeling
claim: Digital-twin feedback identifies physical and sequencing failures before robotic execution.
boundary: PCR experimentally validated; another protocol evaluated computationally. Not general flow-hydraulic simulation.

title: Large language models as uncertainty-calibrated optimizers for experimental discovery
claim: Direct-prompting comparisons report invalid, duplicate and unparsable suggestions in defined reaction search spaces.
boundary: Supports testing admissibility rather than assuming fluent output is valid; not a FlowPilot head-to-head comparison.
